newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Stolichny Bank wins 50 pct of Agroprombank.
newsitem.headline: Russia Stolichny Bank wins 50 pct of Agroprombank.

text.p: Stolichny Bank Sberezheny won a tender for half of troubled Agroprombank, one of Russia's biggest banks, Prime-Tass news agency quoted an Agroprombank official as saying on Friday.
Stolichny will get the 50 percent plus one share stake by taking up a 130 billion roubles share issue which doubles Agroprombank's capital.
It must then transfer 25.5 percent of shares to the government in trust, according to the terms of the tender.
Stolichny has been developing its retail banking operations to compete with Sberbank, the former Soviet monopoly savings bank, which still dominates the sector.
By winning the tender it gains access to Agroprombank's 1,200 branches across the country.
Agroprombank specialises in banking for the agricultural sector and the winner must preserve the share of credits to farmers and agricultural companies in its portfolio.

The winner of the tender must grant a five-year, one trillion rouble credit to Agroprombank at a rate not higher than 50 percentage points over the central bank's refinancing rate, currently 60 percent, to repay Agroprombank's liabilities.
Prime-Tass said Stolichny was to transfer the credit to Agroprombank within 10 days.
The state's current stake in Agroprombank is 1.7 percent.
Bank Imperial also bid in the tender.
